endorsements.quote: Addressing these concerns in practice would require ongoing oversight after AI systems are deployed, supported by governance structures that allocate clear responsibility to healthcare organizations and clinicians for monitoring performance, responding to emerging risks and implementing corrective actions.

unlisted_practices: Demonstrate the safety of medical AI before considering its potential clinical benefits, particularly in screening programs.
Evaluate AI technologies on their effects on clinical outcomes, care delivery, cost-effectiveness and health service performance in addition to benchmark performance.
Use prospective study designs such as hybrid effectiveness-implementation trials and quasi-experimental studies to evaluate AI deployment.
Consider implementation from the earliest stages of AI research.
Adapt AI systems to local healthcare contexts, resources and workflows when scaling them to new settings.
Involve people with lived experience to identify barriers and unintended consequences of AI technologies.
Conduct prospective real-world studies showing how AI affects clinical workflows and the day-to-day experiences of healthcare staff.

screen.reason: Title-only record discussing how to make AI work in healthcare, indicating a perspective or commentary on healthcare AI implementation.
